scope_confirmed_by_user: Multi-source text: digits, uppercase, lowercase, variable length, distortion and occlusion

modules.data: Hash-checked image and mask manifests; answer and pixel isolation audited separately
modules.vocabulary: Explicit character vocabulary, CTC blank, AR BOS/EOS/PAD; repeated symbols preserved
modules.model: Shared 2D SVTR vision, renderer-supervised foreground, independent CTC and causal attention decoders
modules.registry: Explicit legacy and hybrid model adapters with supported decoder declarations
modules.training: Frozen-vision attention warmup, then joint optimization; matched CTC control
modules.evaluation: Case-sensitive whole-string accuracy and CER by source; validation-only model selection
modules.inference: Checkpoint-owned preprocessing and decoding, checksum-checked candidate loading

attention_memory: Full height-by-width encoder grid with 2D sinusoidal positions and image-width padding mask
hybrid_decoding: Candidates from CTC and causal attention; equal-weight sum of their sequence log probabilities
confidence: Sequence scores and branch agreement are diagnostics, not calibrated confidence
installation: Install the Python package in a project virtual environment; network definitions are bundled and do not require an external OCR checkout
legacy: Legacy checkpoints use explicit adapters; local experiment scripts are excluded from Git
acceptance: Pending; architecture implementation and training completion alone do not establish strong generalization
geometry: Checkpoint-defined height and width; positive multiples of 16; tested at 48x320 and 64x448; oversized aspect ratios fail explicitly
augmentation: Optional training-only color and geometric transforms with paired foreground masks and independent random stream; no change to cached images
reproducibility: Automatic source snapshot at experiment startup; checksummed candidate and validation-only selection
usage: Install in the project virtual environment: python -m pip install -e .
Train: captcha-train --config configs/training.json --initial-checkpoint CHECKPOINT --data DATASET_ROOT --output NEW_EXPERIMENT_ROOT
Evaluate: captcha-evaluate --checkpoint CHECKPOINT --mode ctc_multiview --manifest MANIFEST_JSON --output NEW_RESULT_JSON

experimental_architectures.transfer: Neutral residual initialization from shared parent; variant recorded in checkpoint
experimental_architectures.comparison: One 600-step continuation per condition, matched initialization and data; local experiment records are excluded from Git
